description: This file defines the QueueId struct, which is an immutable identifier for a durable queue used within Orleans streaming extensions. It includes properties, constructors, comparison methods, and formatting functionalities related to queue identification.

classes.name: QueueId
classes.description: A struct representing a unique identifier for a durable queue, including methods for comparison, equality, and string formatting.

methods.name: GetQueueId
methods.description: Factory method to create a new QueueId instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetUniformHashCode
methods.description: Returns the stored uniform hash code.

methods.name: IsDefault
methods.description: Indicates whether the QueueId is the default instance.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this QueueId with another for ordering.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the QueueId.

methods.name: ToStringWithHashCode
methods.description: Returns string including the hash code.
